guide.err_dm_blocked: ❌ Could not send a DM (privacy settings).
guide.embed_xp_desc:
• **XP** raises your **global level** and changes your **title** (see **`/mycard`**, **`/profile`**, **`/myrank`**).
• **`/animefav`** — your **favorite anime** on the card; **`/profile`** for details (streak, stats, trophies…).
• Earn it by playing (**`/animequiz`**, guessing games, **`/duel`**, **raid boss**, etc.), with **`/checkin`** (daily + streak) and **`/mission`** (daily goal).
• **`/reportbug`** — report a bug in DMs; if confirmed, **bonus XP** (counter on **`/mycard`**).
• **`/mybadges`** — trophies by tier (Initiate→Myth) · **`/animetop`** / **`/quiztop`** — leaderboards.
• **`/mystats`** — detailed AniList stats once your account is linked.
• **New titles** (global XP or quiz): announced in the game channel, or in a dedicated channel with **`/setlevelupchannel`** (not one line per intermediate XP level).
guide.embed_mini_desc:
• **/animequiz** · **/duel** · **/guessop** · **/minijeux** (guess menus / more)
• **/higherlower** · **/guesswho** · **/chainquiz**
• **Raid boss** — server event if **`/raidconfig`** is set (signup + rounds).

_Tip: a dedicated minigames channel keeps general chat readable._
guide.embed_anilist_desc:
**Link:** `/linkanilist <username>` then paste the **code** in your AniList bio and **`/verifyanilist`**.
**Personal:** `/mystats` · `/monnext` · `/monplanning`

**Server** commands (`/next`, `/planning` server mode, alerts) use **`/airings`**, not your account. **Personal** commands need a link.
guide.embed_reminders_desc:
• **`/recap`** — panel (buttons + time input) to enable the **“Releases today”** digest; **`/setalert HH:MM`** for a specific time.
• Independent from server alerts (`/setchannel`).

**`/next` / `/planning`** — **server** mode = **`/airings`** list · **global** mode = broad releases.
**`/monnext` / `/monplanning`** — **your** AniList schedule (linked account).
guide.embed_misc_desc:
• **`/stats @member`** — member’s AniList card (if linked)
• **`/botinfo`** · **`/ping`** — bot version, latency
• **`/help`** — command list; **`/help <name>`** — details
• **Admins:** server setup in DMs with **`/guide_admin`**.
guide.embed_support_desc:
Need help? **{support}** — ID `{sid}`
You can reply directly to this DM.

guide_admin.need_guild: ❌ Use this command in a server.
guide_admin.err_dm_blocked: ❌ DMs closed — open your private messages to receive the admin guide.
guide_admin.err_dm_blocked_short: ❌ DMs closed — open your private messages.
guide_admin.embed_srv_desc:
**1) `/airings` list** — `all`, add/remove; basis for server **`/next`** and **`/planning`** and “episode out” cards.
**2) `/setchannel`** — channel for **episode release** cards (images).
**3) `/setlevelupchannel`** — channel for **announcements**: **new global title** (XP) and **new quiz title** (monthly score, `/animequiz` / `/animequizmulti`); otherwise the channel where the game runs. **`/clearlevelupchannel`** to reset.
**4) `/raidconfig`** (admins) — panel (channel, auto, day, time); **`/raid statut`** for everyone; manual **`/raidstart`** (1×/week per server after confirmation).
guide_admin.embed_note_desc:
• **Quiz titles** (monthly score tiers, `/quiztop`) are **separate** from global XP titles; both can post in **`/setlevelupchannel`**.
• The **raid** announces XP at the end with `announce=False` on the raid channel (no level spam during the recap).

utils.setchannel_ok:
✅ This channel will receive **episode release cards** for **this server**.
• Tracked anime list: **`/airings`** (e.g. **`/airings all`** for admins).
• **Independent** from the **raid boss** channel (`/raidconfig`).
• If you get **no** alerts while the list is filled: check **bot permissions** here, and that the AniList API responds (alerts use the post-air window).
utils.setlevelup_ok:
✅ This channel will receive the following **announcements** (instead of the channel where play happens):
• **New global title** (XP `/profile`, `/myrank`) — one announcement per **title tier**, not every level.
• **New quiz title** (solo quiz score `/animequiz`, `/animequizmulti`) — same tiers as on the card.
• To reset default behaviour: **`/clearlevelupchannel`**.
utils.clearlevelup_ok: ✅ Level-up announcements will again be posted **in the channel where the game happened** (or not announced if XP was granted without a channel).

reportbug.reject_wait_short: ⏳ You need to wait a bit longer before submitting another report.
reportbug.reject_cooldown:
⏳ **Reporting temporarily unavailable**

Your last report was **rejected with a penalty** (deliberate **false** report / troll / obvious abuse). You can use **`/reportbug`** again after **{until}** (Paris time).

**Good-faith** reports that turn out not to be bugs are handled **without** this penalty.
reportbug.daily:
📅 **Daily limit reached**

You already sent a report **today** (Paris timezone). One report per day — **one bug** at a time. Try again **tomorrow after midnight**.
reportbug.blacklist:
🚫 **Bug reporting disabled**

You no longer have access to the bug reporting system.
reportbug.modal_repro_ph: If you can’t reproduce, explain why (≥12 characters).
reportbug.hint_cmd: Say **which command or system** is affected (this field can stay short, e.g. `/quiz`).
reportbug.hint_total: The **total** text must be at least **{min}** characters (all fields combined).
reportbug.hint_fields: The **observed issue**, **expected behaviour** and **reproduction steps** fields must each be at least **{min}** characters. The **command / system** field can stay short.
reportbug.preview_footer: One bug per report — check before sending.
reportbug.draft_expired: ⏱️ This draft expired. Run **`/reportbug`** again from a server.
reportbug.save_fail: ❌ Could not save the report right now. Try again later.
reportbug.embed_footer_owner: 🔍 Dismissed = not a bug, no penalty · ✖️ Reject = troll/deliberate false (7d) · ✅ Confirm = XP
reportbug.owner_dm_fail: ❌ The owner could not be reached by **DM** right now. Your report was **not** saved. Try again later.
reportbug.sent_ok: ✅ **Report sent** to the owner. You’ll get a reply in **DMs** once it’s processed.
reportbug.report_gone: This report is no longer pending (already handled or not found).
reportbug.dismiss_body:
Thanks for your feedback — it was **read and reviewed**.

In this case it **wasn’t a bot bug** in the sense of something to fix for a reward: e.g. **bot restart**, **AniList API** temporarily down, **already fixed** behaviour, or an **extremely rare** case.

**No penalty** applies: you can keep using **`/reportbug`** normally (subject to the daily limit).

_The **7-day** penalty only applies to **deliberate** false reports (troll / obvious abuse)._
reportbug.dismiss_edit: **Dismissed** — not a real bug, **no penalty** (user notified).
reportbug.refuse_body:
Your report was **rejected with a penalty**: it was a **deliberate false** report, **troll** or **obvious abuse** (not an honest mistake).

You can’t use **`/reportbug`** for **7 days**.

_Serious reports that aren’t bugs (API, restart, etc.) are handled **without** this penalty._
reportbug.pending_only: This report is no longer pending.
reportbug.validation_hint: Choose **severity** and whether the bug was **hard to find**, then **Grant reward**.
reportbug.pick_sev_hard: Choose **severity** and whether the bug was **hard to find** before validating.
reportbug.confirm_user_thanks: Thanks for helping improve the bot!
reportbug.dm_blocked:
🔒 **Can’t open your report**

Your **DMs** are closed or the bot can’t message you.

**Enable DMs** (Settings → Privacy → direct messages) so the bot can send the form **privately**. This avoids posting a bug in the server and duplicate copy-paste reports.

There is **no** channel posting: everything goes through DMs.

• **Without auto**: admins use **`/raidstart`**.
• **`/raid statut`** (ephemeral): recap without changing settings.

**Channel** · **weekday** · **hour** · **minutes** (steps of 5) · **Auto** buttons · **HH:MM** for exact minute.
**Save** closes the panel with a confirmation · **Close** closes without a message.

community_games.join_embed_desc:
Choose the **challenge type** for **all** your rounds.
• **Easy** = character (4 choices) and **genre** — wrong picks = **less damage** if you eventually get it. **Medium** = year, episodes, higher/lower (same). **Hard** = **screenshot** (type the title in channel like **`/animequiz`**) and blurred **guess who**.
• Harder modes → **more damage** and **higher finisher** bonus.
• _If you don’t pick before signup ends → **{default_mode}**._

community_games.hit_high:

community_games.hit_mid:

community_games.hit_low:

⚡ _One more push!_
community_games.raid_start_body:
✅ **{n}** participant(s) — the boss has **{hp}** HP (_{per} × {n} for the team_).
• Up to **{maxr}** rounds — **~{secs} s** max **per round** if someone hasn’t answered yet.
• **Damage per correct answer** depends on the **mode** you picked at signup (see your ephemeral message) — harder modes hit harder.
• **Hits** and the **log** (embed) show the fight; mistakes / timeouts stay in the log.
community_games.round_timeout_msg: ⏰ **Round {n}** over — the boss still stands (**{hp}** HP).
community_games.force_finish: 🔥 **Final salvo!** The raid ends: the boss falls (**{hp}** HP left counted as defeated).
community_games.victory_summary: **{np}** player(s) · **{nr}** round(s) · duration **~{dur}** · damage dealt **{td}** (boss **{maxhp}** HP)
community_games.promo:
⚔️ **BOSS RAID (weekly)** — Signups open **~{join}s** _(**fixed** timer from start; it doesn’t extend with each signup)_.
• Each player gets their **own** challenge (**ephemeral** in the channel).
• **Random damage** per correct answer: range depends on **mode** at signup.
• Up to **{maxr}** rounds; boss HP = **players** × {per_player}.
• When **everyone** finishes (success, fail, or timeout) → next round without waiting for the timer.
• XP: base + damage share + MVP + fastest round + finisher.
community_games.signup_desc: Click to join the fight. **Voice not required.**
community_games.alert_1h: @here ⏰ **Boss Raid** in **1 h** — get ready (quiz / AniList chars)!
community_games.raid_no_channel: ❌ No raid channel configured. Open **`/raidconfig`** and pick a **channel** in the menu.
community_games.raid_limit_cmd:
❌ **Limit reached**: **`/raidstart`** can only be used **once per week** per server (ISO week **{wk}**). Try again next week.
_**Auto** weekly raid (**Auto: ON** in **`/raidconfig`**) doesn’t count toward this limit._
community_games.raid_confirm_desc:
You’re about to start an immediate **Boss Raid**.

• **After confirming**, this server can’t use **`/raidstart`** again until **next week** (**1 × per ISO week**, here: **{wk}**).
• **Auto** weekly raid (**Auto: ON** in **`/raidconfig`**) is **not** consumed by this limit.

**Raid channel:** {ch}

Click **Confirm** only if you accept.

intro.title: 👋 Thanks for adding AnimeBot!
intro.lead: Here is the **recommended order** so your server gets episode alerts and “server list” commands, then a **quick overview** for your members.
intro.admin_value:
**1) Fill the server list — `/airings`**
Use **`all`** (browse releases) or add/remove one by one. This is the **list used** by **`/next`** and **`/planning`** in **server** mode. **While it’s empty**, there are no upcoming episodes on the server side and **no** “episode out” cards.

**2) Pick the announcements channel — `/setchannel`**
Run it **in the channel** where you want **cards** when a listed episode airs (same list as `/airings`).

**3) Raid boss (optional) — `/raidconfig`**
Raid channel, **day/time**, auto start or not. To try it: **`/raidstart`** (admins).

**4) XP level-up channel (optional) — `/setlevelupchannel`**
Channel where **level-up** messages are centralized (otherwise: the channel where the game runs). See **`/guide_admin`** (DM) for full staff setup.
intro.minigames_value:
**Worth showing on the server**
• **/next** · **/planning** — **server** mode = `/airings` list; **global** mode = all releases.
• **/animequiz** · **/duel** · **/guessop** · **/minijeux** — **/animetop** for minigame leaderboards.
• **Raid boss** (community minigame) once **`/raidconfig`** is set.
intro.extra_tips: Use **`/guide`** for the **player** tutorial in DMs; **`/guide_admin`** (admins) for airings, announcement channels, levels, raid, etc.
intro.contact: Need help? Contact **{support}** (ID `{sid}`) — I reply quickly.
intro.guild_join_blocked:
👋 **{mention}** thanks for adding **AnimeBot**.
I sent you a **setup recap** in DMs, but your DMs are closed.
**TL;DR:** fill **`/airings`** (server list), then **`/setchannel`** in the announcements channel — optional: **`/raidconfig`** for the raid boss.
Open your DMs or use **`/guide`** (players) / **`/guide_admin`** (staff) for the tutorials.

fallback: In Japan, “anime” refers to all animation, not only the series we usually watch here.
Many anime openings and endings are original songs made for the show.
Anime seasons are often named after months (e.g. January, April, July, October).
Animation studios often collaborate: one series can involve several production houses.
A TV “cour” is typically a broadcast block of about 11–13 episodes.
Light novels and manga are still very common sources for anime adaptations.
Episode quality can vary depending on guest directors or per-episode teams.
Simulcasts let you follow a series alongside its Japanese broadcast.
